title: Slugs with accents and long titles
prompt:
Blog post URLs come out wrong: `slugify` in app/text.py drops accented letters ("Café" becomes "caf"), leaves double
dashes and can end with a dash after cutting to `max_len`. Fix it: accents are transliterated to ASCII ("Café à
Luanda" → "cafe-a-luanda"), any run of non-alphanumerics becomes one dash, no dash at the start or end, and cutting to
`max_len` never leaves a trailing dash. Keep the signature.
